none: PAS LANCUM-4BD7B7: Roman coin: Denarius struck during the revolt of Vindex against Nero
contea di ritrovamento: Cumbria (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver Roman denarius of the Civil War period, dating to AD 68 (Reece period 3). Reverse type depicting the legend SP.QR within an oak(?) wreath. Mint of Gaul. As RIC I (2nd ed.), p. 209, no. 73b var; cf.BMC p. 297, no. 31. This rare coin was struck by Vindex, governor of Gallia Lugdunensis, during his revolt against Nero in March-May AD 68.
